sample_problems.title: How can I learn consistently?
sample_problems.description: I keep starting new study routines and dropping them within a week. Looking for a practical system that survives busy weeks, not just motivation.
sample_problems.author: Demo User

solutions.author: Ananya Singh
solutions.content: A fixed 25-minute block right after breakfast, before checking your phone. Consistency beats duration - 25 minutes daily compounds faster than a weekend binge.

sample_problems.title: Slow MySQL queries on a growing orders table
sample_problems.description: Our orders table crossed 2M rows and a few dashboard queries went from 200ms to 4s+. We already have indexes on user_id and created_at.
sample_problems.author: Demo User

solutions.author: Rahul Verma
solutions.content: Try a composite index matching your WHERE + ORDER BY, e.g. (user_id, created_at). Then run EXPLAIN to confirm it is used instead of a filesort.

solutions.author: Priya Sharma
solutions.content: Also consider archiving old rows to a history table and paginating with a keyset (WHERE id < last_id) instead of OFFSET.

sample_problems.title: Local bakery losing walk-in customers to delivery apps
sample_problems.description: A family-run bakery near me is struggling since delivery platforms took over. Looking for low-cost ways to bring back foot traffic.
sample_problems.author: Priya Sharma

solutions.author: Ankit Raj
solutions.content: Fresh-bake time boards outside the shop, a loyalty stamp card and a Google Maps listing with real photos brought steady walk-ins for similar shops.

sample_problems.title: Laptop becomes slow after installing development tools
sample_problems.description: My laptop lags badly when VS Code, Docker and a browser are open together. Looking for optimization ideas on 8GB RAM.
sample_problems.author: Rahul Verma

solutions.author: Demo User
solutions.content: Limit Docker Desktop memory in settings, disable unused VS Code extensions, and keep browser tabs under control. An SSD upgrade helps the most.

sample_problems.title: Practical roadmap for landing my first internship
sample_problems.description: What should a beginner learn and build to become internship-ready within 6 months?
sample_problems.author: Ankit Raj

solutions.author: Rahul Verma
solutions.content: Months 1-2: one language + DSA basics. Months 3-4: two small full-stack projects with a database. Months 5-6: apply weekly, polish GitHub and resume.

solutions.author: Ananya Singh
solutions.content: Add a README with screenshots to every project. Recruiters skim - make your best work obvious in 10 seconds.

sample_problems.title: Our street floods every monsoon
sample_problems.description: Water logging near the colony entrance blocks vehicles for days. How do residents effectively escalate this to the local authority?
sample_problems.author: Ankit Raj

sample_problems.title: Cannot focus while studying at home with a noisy family
sample_problems.description: Home is busy in the evenings and I cannot concentrate. Looking for realistic ways to create a focus window.
sample_problems.author: Ananya Singh

solutions.author: Priya Sharma
solutions.content: Shift your deep-work block to early morning, use noise-cancelling earbuds with brown noise, and tell family your fixed hours in advance.
